description: Request review of a missing specialization, skill or company industry, as on freehire's dictionary page. This records a suggestion, not a new working filter or a vacancy. Existing terms and aliases are refused. Repeated requests share the existing queue entry and increase request_count; status is the entry's review state. Use for a specialization, skill or industry the user wanted to filter by but the dictionary cannot resolve; an empty job search alone is not evidence of a missing term. Send the user's original term once per missing term, without requiring a separate request to suggest it. Tell the user it was requested for review, not added to the filters.

kind.description: The dictionary to extend: a job specialization, skill, or company industry.

term.description: The missing term in the user's words, up to 80 characters after trimming.

name: suggest_dictionary_term
title: Suggest a dictionary term
